A_5_1.title: Policies for Information Security
A_5_1.description: Define, approve, publish, and annually review information security policies covering all relevant topics.

A_5_2.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
A_5_2.description: Assign and document roles and responsibilities for information security across the organization.

A_5_3.title: Segregation of Duties
A_5_3.description: Separate conflicting duties and responsibilities to reduce opportunities for unauthorized modification of information.

A_5_4.title: Management Responsibilities
A_5_4.description: Management must require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with established policies.

A_5_5.title: Contact with Authorities
A_5_5.description: Maintain appropriate contacts with relevant authorities (data protection authority, cybersecurity agency, law enforcement).

A_5_6.title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
A_5_6.description: Maintain membership or contact with special interest groups, security forums, and professional associations.

A_5_7.title: Threat Intelligence
A_5_7.description: Collect, analyse, and produce threat intelligence relevant to the organization to anticipate and prepare for threats.

A_5_8.title: Information Security in Project Management
A_5_8.description: Integrate information security into project management to ensure security risks are addressed during projects.

A_5_9.title: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
A_5_9.description: Identify, document, and maintain an inventory of information and associated assets with assigned ownership.

A_5_10.title: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
A_5_10.description: Identify, document, and implement acceptable use rules for information and assets, covering devices, data handling, and prohibited activities.

A_5_11.title: Return of Assets
A_5_11.description: Ensure all assets are returned upon termination or change of employment or contract.

A_5_12.title: Classification of Information
A_5_12.description: Classify information by sensitivity (confidential, internal, public) to ensure appropriate handling and protection.

A_5_13.title: Labelling of Information
A_5_13.description: Develop and implement a labelling procedure for information in accordance with the classification scheme.

A_5_14.title: Information Transfer
A_5_14.description: Establish rules and procedures for information transfer via all channels including email, messaging, physical media, and verbal.

A_5_15.title: Access Control
A_5_15.description: Define and implement access control rules based on business and security requirements, using least privilege.

A_5_16.title: Identity Management
A_5_16.description: Manage the full identity lifecycle (provisioning, changes, revocation) for all users and service accounts.

A_5_17.title: Authentication Information
A_5_17.description: Manage authentication information (passwords, keys, tokens) through a formal process including allocation, storage, and revocation.

A_5_18.title: Access Rights
A_5_18.description: Provision, review, modify, and remove access rights in accordance with the access control policy.

A_5_19.title: Information Security in Supplier Relationships
A_5_19.description: Identify and implement controls to protect assets accessible to suppliers; document requirements in supplier agreements.

A_5_20.title: Addressing Information Security Within Supplier Agreements
A_5_20.description: Establish and agree information security requirements with each supplier that may access, process, or store organizational information.

A_5_21.title: Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain
A_5_21.description: Define and implement processes for managing information security risks associated with ICT products and services supply chain.

A_5_22.title: Monitoring, Review and Change Management of Supplier Services
A_5_22.description: Regularly monitor, review, and manage changes to supplier information security practices and service delivery.

A_5_23.title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
A_5_23.description: Establish processes for acquiring, using, managing, and exiting from cloud services, including security requirements and exit plans.

A_5_24.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
A_5_24.description: Plan and prepare for incident management with defined roles, responsibilities, procedures, and communication channels.

A_5_25.title: Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
A_5_25.description: Assess information security events and decide whether they qualify as incidents using a defined classification scheme.

A_5_26.title: Response to Information Security Incidents
A_5_26.description: Respond to incidents in accordance with documented procedures; contain, eradicate, and recover in a structured way.

A_5_27.title: Learning from Information Security Incidents
A_5_27.description: Use knowledge from incidents to reduce the likelihood and impact of future incidents; update controls accordingly.

A_5_28.title: Collection of Evidence
A_5_28.description: Define and apply procedures for identifying, collecting, acquiring, and preserving evidence of information security incidents.

A_5_29.title: Information Security During Disruption
A_5_29.description: Plan how information security will be maintained during disruption. Integrate security requirements into business continuity plans.

A_5_30.title: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
A_5_30.description: Plan, implement, maintain, and test ICT readiness based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

A_5_31.title: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
A_5_31.description: Identify, document, and keep current all legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security.

A_5_32.title: Intellectual Property Rights
A_5_32.description: Implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights and comply with software licensing requirements.

A_5_33.title: Protection of Records
A_5_33.description: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with legal requirements.

A_5_34.title: Privacy and Protection of PII
A_5_34.description: Identify and meet privacy and personal data protection requirements in accordance with applicable law (GDPR).

A_5_35.title: Independent Review of Information Security
A_5_35.description: Review the ISMS approach and implementation independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

A_5_36.title: Compliance with Policies, Rules and Standards for Information Security
A_5_36.description: Regularly review compliance with information security policies, standards, and procedures; document results.

A_5_37.title: Documented Operating Procedures
A_5_37.description: Document, maintain, and make available operating procedures for information processing facilities.
